title: The Asset of Marseille's old port
author: Jude Ravensworth
blurb: Odile Nystrom, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
